topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I’ve always found comfort in the rhythm of this place, the old creaks in the floorboards that sing to me each morning, the walls that echo the whispers of a life well-lived. But now, it seems, the building has other plans. News trickles down the hall as I pass my neighbor, her face a mirror of the storm brewing inside me. Condos. The word hangs in the air like a fog, changing everything. It’s not just a change of ownership; it’s a shift in the soul of this place. I walk back to my apartment, the familiar path suddenly heavy under my feet, wondering what this new chapter will bring.
